Info

Defines structural protocol IPlanarKinematicsSolver for 2D SCARA arm calculations.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.solver.analytical.planar.isolver.IPlanarKinematicsSolver(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining planar 2D SCARA arm forward and inverse kinematics.

It defines:

methods:
solve_fk_2d - Computes end-effector Cartesian coordinate from joint angles.
solve_fk_pose_2d - Computes Cartesian positions of elbow and tool joints.
solve_ik_2d - Solves analytical inverse kinematics for joint angles.
get_version - Returns solver component version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
get_version() → str[source]¶

Returns solver component version string representation.

Returns:

Semantic version string.

solve_fk_2d(theta1: float, theta2: float) → Point2D[source]¶

Computes Cartesian end-effector position from joint angles via 2D forward kinematics.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

Returns:

Point2D Cartesian coordinate instance in mm.

solve_fk_pose_2d(theta1: float, theta2: float) → tuple[Point2D, Point2D][source]¶

Computes Cartesian coordinates of both elbow joint and end-effector tool in 2D.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

Returns:

Tuple of (elbow_point, tool_point) Point2D coordinate instances in mm.

solve_ik_2d(point: Point2D, elbow_left: bool = False) → ScaraJoints2D[source]¶

Solves analytical inverse kinematics for SCARA 2-DOF planar arm.

Parameters:

  • point – Target planar Cartesian coordinate point in mm.

  • elbow_left – True for elbow-left configuration, False for elbow-right.

Returns:

ScaraJoints2D instance containing joint angles, reachability and status.
